name: Hansen Plastics Corporation

about:
Hansen Plastics Corporation operates from Elgin, Illinois, where it was founded in 1971 by Elmer Hansen. The company transitioned to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan in 1991 and became 100% employee-owned by 1998, a structure the firm says embeds a "do it right the first time" tradition into daily operations.

The shop runs more than 70 injection molding presses ranging from 28 to 500 tons across over 150,000 square feet of production space. Core processes include horizontal, vertical/insert, multi-material, and decoupled molding, supported by RJG scientific molding with cavity-pressure transducers. Value-added services span in-mold decorating, hot stamping, pad printing, machining, tapping, turning, drilling, ultrasonic welding, thermal insertion, hand assembly, and custom packaging. The company handles volumes from prototypes to high‑volume runs.

Customers include OEMs and manufacturers across North America in automotive, life safety, appliances, fluid movement and water treatment, construction, transportation (non‑automotive), agriculture, and water filtration. Testimonials cite long‑term relationships with buyers in automotive tooling and water delivery equipment.

Leadership attributes the company’s differentiation to its employee‑owner culture, ISO 9001:2015 certification, lean manufacturing practices, and statistical process controls tied to business systems. The founder, Elmer Hansen, remains on the board, reinforcing the original quality motto.
